selection_rationale: Next Karachi universities in the 67-university seed with confirmed computing BS programmes: KIET (BS CS/AI/SE/Cyber, 2026-27 fees published), Hamdard (BS CS/AI/SE, 2026-27 fees), Salim Habib (BS CS/AI/SE/DS), SMIU (public, low-fee BS CS/SE/AI/DS), Ziauddin (BS CS/SE/DS) and Indus (BS CS/SE, Fall 2026 fees). Aga Khan skipped (no computing UG); Greenwich, Newports, JUW, BBSUL and PNEC deferred (thin or unverified computing data in seed).
